summary: Full-stack testing of new Admin panel + regression. Backend: 19/19 pytest passed — public (grades/lessons/404s), admin auth (wrong pw→401, correct→JWT token, /verify no-token→401, bad-token→401, valid→{ok:true}), admin write endpoints without token→401 (POST/PUT/DELETE), full CRUD flow (create g7-xxxxxx lesson, verify in /api/lessons + /api/grades/g7, update title/theory, delete → 404), edge cases (unknown grade→400, update/delete nonexistent→404), seeded 47 preserved. Frontend /admin: wrong password shows admin-login-error 'Λάθος κωδικός'; correct password → list of 47 lessons grouped by 3 grades; 'Νέο μάθημα' → 7-section editor; filled grade+chapter+title+theory+1 interactive question with correct option B → Save returned to list with new lesson visible (48 rows); Edit changed title → reflected in list; Delete (window.confirm accepted) removed row; Έξοδος cleared admin-token from localStorage and returned to login gate. Regression OK: /, /grade/g7, /lesson/g7-1-1 all render normally (KaTeX intact, screenshot shows g7-1-1 lesson w/ theory, example, sections). Test data cleaned up (created lesson deleted).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — migrate to lifespan.
require_admin dependency correctly returns 401 for missing/bad/expired token — good use of secrets.compare_digest for the password check.
LessonUpsert.order is Optional[int] and admin_create_lesson auto-computes next order from the last lesson of the same grade — correct.
seed_database uses $setOnInsert so re-seeds do not overwrite admin edits — correct.
JWT secret is present in backend/.env (non-empty 64-hex). ADMIN_PASSWORD stored as plain string is acceptable for single-admin MVP but consider hashing if the app grows.

Frontend admin uses axios with Bearer header from localStorage 'admin-token'; a global 401 interceptor to auto-clearToken/redirect would improve UX when the 12h token expires (currently the user only sees a hard failure until reload).
test_credentials: Admin password mathadmin2026 (from backend/.env ADMIN_PASSWORD); frontend base URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
seed_data_creation: One transient TEST_UI_* lesson (g7-abcfaa) created via UI and deleted at end. One TEST_* lesson created via pytest and deleted in finally block. DB left in seeded state (47 lessons).
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py now covers public endpoints + admin auth + admin CRUD (19 tests, 1.8s). Admin token acquired via session fixture. All admin write endpoints require Bearer token. UI flow verified: /admin login gate → list (48 rows after create, back to 47 after delete) → editor (7 sections, data-testids: editor-grade/category/chapter/minutes/title/theory/save/cancel; ix-add/ix-prompt-N/ix-opt-N-M/ix-correct-N-M/ix-expl-N for interactive questions, test-* for assessment) → row testids admin-row-{id}, admin-edit-{id}, admin-delete-{id}, admin-logout. window.confirm dialog handled via page.on('dialog', accept).
